choose.when: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_index, heading_path, heading_level, content, embedding_vec, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{headingPath}, #{headingLevel}, #{content}, CAST(#{embeddingVector} AS vector), CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_index, heading_path, heading_level, content, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{headingPath}, #{headingLevel}, #{content}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})

mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, d.source_id, s.name AS source_name, d.path, d.title, c.heading_path, c.heading_level, c.content, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'startLine')::int, 0) AS start_line, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'endLine')::int, 0) AS end_line, 0 AS score, (1 - (c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))) AS similarity FROM ai_knowledge_chunk c JOIN ai_knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id JOIN ai_knowledge_source s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.source_id IN #{sid} AND c.embedding_vec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector), c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
